title: San Francisco Addresses (EAS)
description: Point addresses from the City and County of San Francisco Enterprise Addressing System, a 5,000-feature extract of the official DataSF open data layer, converted to cloud-native GeoParquet with a PMTiles visualization. The source asset points at the full live DataSF layer.

providers.name: City and County of San Francisco

table:columns.name: street_full_street_name
table:columns.description: Street name and type together.

table:columns.name: zip_code
table:columns.description: Five-digit ZIP code as a string.

table:columns.name: latitude
table:columns.description: Latitude as text. Prefer the geometry column.

table:columns.name: address_number_suffix
table:columns.description: Street number suffix such as A, null for nearly all rows.

table:columns.name: complete_landmark_name
table:columns.description: Landmark name for the few rows that carry one, Millennium Tower.

table:columns.name: eas_fullid
table:columns.description: Unique row identifier, base id, sub id, and parcel link id joined with dashes. The only column unique per row.

table:columns.name: direct_source
table:columns.description: Where the record entered the EAS, SF DBI, State of CA, or The Presidio Trust.

table:columns.name: cnn
table:columns.description: Centerline Network Number, the street-segment key of the city basemap, joins to the DataSF street centerlines.

table:columns.name: data_loaded_at
table:columns.description: When the portal loaded the record.

table:columns.name: longitude
table:columns.description: Longitude as text. Prefer the geometry column.

table:columns.name: street_name
table:columns.description: Parsed street name.

table:columns.name: eas_baseid
table:columns.description: Identifier of the base address, the building. Units share it, so count distinct eas_baseid for buildings.

table:columns.name: nhood
table:columns.description: DataSF analysis neighborhood name, joins to the Analysis Neighborhoods dataset by name.

table:columns.name: block
table:columns.description: Assessor block number as a string.

table:columns.name: street_type
table:columns.description: Parsed street type, ST or AVE. Null for streets like BROADWAY that have no type.

table:columns.name: eas_subid
table:columns.description: Identifier of the sub-address, a unit or apartment, within its base.

table:columns.name: lot
table:columns.description: Assessor lot number as a string.

table:columns.name: address
table:columns.description: Full address string, with the unit as a hash suffix when present.

table:columns.name: unit_number
table:columns.description: Unit designator, null on base-address rows.

table:columns.name: supervisor
table:columns.description: Supervisor district number as a string.

table:columns.name: data_updated_at
table:columns.description: Record update timestamp, with a 1970 epoch sentinel on never-updated rows.

table:columns.name: address_number
table:columns.description: Street number.

table:columns.name: parcel_number
table:columns.description: Assessor parcel number, block plus lot. Null on 32 percent of rows, a parcel join drops them silently.

table:columns.name: data_as_of
table:columns.description: Snapshot timestamp of the upstream export, July 24, 2026 for every row here.

table:columns.name: geom
table:columns.description: Address point, WGS84 longitude and latitude. Units stack on their building's single point.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct(xmin double, ymin double, xmax double, ymax double)
table:columns.description: Per-feature bounding box struct, the GeoParquet covering.

thumbnail.title: Preview thumbnail over a light basemap. © OpenStreetMap contributors © CARTO.

style-addresses.title: Address points
style-addresses.description: All 5,000 sampled address records as uniform points.

style-sources.title: Where each record entered the EAS
style-sources.description: direct_source separates the DBI-approved records from the State of CA batch and the handful from the Presidio Trust.

style-units.title: Unit records against base addresses
style-units.description: Orange where the record carries a unit_number, teal for base addresses, the coalesce guards against both null and absent attributes.

style-neighborhoods.title: Analysis neighborhoods
style-neighborhoods.description: nhood from the cycling catalog palette, forty neighborhoods, so colours repeat, adjacency keeps them readable.

style-density.title: Address density heatmap
style-density.description: A MapLibre heatmap over the sample. Density reflects the sample's internal ordering, not San Francisco, see the README caveat.
